integrity: The proof uses the exact covariance identity for doubly centered permutation linear statistics and explicit polynomial sums. Exact permutation enumeration and exact matrix double-centering are supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: The formulas assume a uniform random permutation and complete rankings without ties.
The result gives a null dependence calculation, not a power comparison under alternatives.
A 1997 paper comparing the footrule with Spearman's coefficient was available only at abstract level and remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact permutation-null correlation of Spearman footrule and rho
